# Tutorial: Set up the Visual Configurator

This tutorial walks through configuring the Visual Configurator desktop application.

## Prerequisites

- Windows 10 or later
- 2 GB of free disk space

## Step 1: Install the application

Run the installer and follow the setup wizard. Choose the installation directory and select the components you want.

## Step 2: Configure your profile

In the profile screen, enter your display name and upload an avatar. Choose a theme from the dropdown.

## Step 3: Connect a data source

On the connections screen, add your database credentials. The form has fields for host, port, username, and password, with a "Test connection" button.

## Step 4: Verify

The main window should show your profile and a green status indicator for the connection.
